desc: C5: make the merge operation's completion handoff timestamp and merged history time persist in UTC, keeping local-offset state loadable
done_when: Both values written by the final MERGED transaction are UTC in memory and persist with a Z suffix under a non-UTC local zone; a state and an archived terminal task with local-offset values for both fields load, validate and keep the same instants, and a later state write leaves those values unchanged; focused tests prove each and fail on pre-C5 code; acceptance evidence names the resolved function and file; the production diff changes only those two clock readings; no golden changes except one asserting those values; E1 plus ops race pass.
scope: The two clock readings in the merge MERGED transaction (wherever Scope 15 placed them), focused tests in internal/ops or internal/db, goldens asserting those two values. Out: every other timestamp (reconciliation path, agent clean-terminal handoff), load/write normalisation, migration, model, schema, rendering, guard data, ADR and chain-serialized doc edits, refactors.
